limits: All paths are exact external retained audit locations; no raw run, credential or session payload is copied.
Hashes bind current external raw bytes, not normalized Git copies.
The original source-analysis reviews name /root/standards_review and /root/spec_review; later review document identities are their exact file hashes, without inferring unnamed author identities.
Historical pending states in earlier plans/reviews are superseded only by explicitly indexed later evidence within its finite scope.
Build supervisor review and source-only candidate reviews do not prove compilation or candidate behavior.
No original Python/SymPy notebook execution, general primality, GUI Clipboard/saved-session, whole-lesson, current-release or source-wide certification.
